svg.title: Twenty-two frozen regions, five motion questions
svg.desc: A matrix compares cross-season alignment, internal directional similarity, maximum seasonal turn, screened border orientation, and maximum screened cut-through for every frozen OSW region. Missing screened border evidence is shown as a dash. No composite rank or region revision is produced.
svg.metadata: Source artifact SHA-256 bb1aa2d76de6bc6438114561f8d2401b2c88f24c5b00a521bbf324d354c9ec15. Columns are deliberately not combined into one score. Different diagnostics can disagree, and missing screened borders are evidence limits rather than zero values.
